FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Nexyra Tech, our services, and how we work.

What type of businesses do you work with?

We work with Government & State-Owned Entities, Financial Services & Fintech, Energy & Mining, and Corporate Enterprise. We understand regulated, high-pressure environments.

What services do you offer?

We offer five core service pillars: Cybersecurity & Digital Risk, Data Analytics & Intelligence, Full-Stack Software Engineering, Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure, and Program & Delivery Leadership.

How quickly can we get started?

We start with a scoping conversation. Most engagements are active within two to three weeks of an initial agreement. Response time to enquiries is under 12 hours.

How does pricing work?

Every engagement is scoped individually. We don't sell packages before understanding your problem. Contact us for a no-obligation conversation.

Where are you based?

Our headquarters is at 120 11th Street, Parkmore, Sandton. We serve clients across South Africa and internationally.
